description: This header defines a templated utility class 'prefixed_logger' for adding prefixes to log entries and providing various logging methods with different levels and data types, integrating with the ocudulog logging system.

classes.name: prefixed_logger
classes.description: A utility class for adding a prefix to log messages and supporting various logging levels and data types.

methods.name: prefixed_logger
methods.description: Constructor initializing the logger with a name and prefix.

methods.name: set_prefix
methods.description: Sets or updates the prefix string for log entries.

methods.name: log_debug
methods.description: Logs a debug level message with formatting.

methods.name: log_info
methods.description: Logs an info level message with formatting.

methods.name: log_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning level message with formatting.

methods.name: log_error
methods.description: Logs an error level message with formatting.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level with formatting.

methods.name: get_basic_logger
methods.description: Returns a reference to the underlying basic_logger.
